_doc: OPTIONAL per-campaign approved-creative registry. When a calendar campaign_id has an entry here AND the referenced file exists and passes the same QA validators, the live orchestrator attaches THAT approved, human-built Output HTML to the Klaviyo draft VERBATIM — instead of regenerating a (different) creative from BigCommerce. This is opt-in and gated per campaign: an absent entry = the default regeneration pipeline (unchanged). Duplicate protection, audience selection (from the calendar row), sender resolution, and DRAFT-only behavior are all unchanged. RDD and any unlisted campaign are unaffected. Each value: { html: repo-relative path (required), subject: draft subject to match the approved creative (optional; falls back to the calendar subject_line), preview_text: draft preheader (optional; falls back to calendar preview_text, then auto-generated per CLAUDE.md §6.24) }.
